user_query: I want to fetch link previews for URLs shared by users on my website by parsing OGP meta data.

TaskList.description: Collect a list of URLs shared by users on the website.
For each URL from the list, make a request to fetch the HTML content.
Parse the HTML content to extract OGP meta data such as title, description, images, icons, canonical URL, and sitename.
Compile the extracted OGP meta data into a structured format.
Return the compiled OGP meta data back to the user or display it on the website.
